final.headline: Demand is steady at ₹13.7 lakh, but supply problems at Purrline, NutriPaws and Litterly put stock at risk
final.narrative:
Category GMV was ₹13.7 lakh for the week of 19 Oct to 25 Oct, up 0.5% on the week before, so demand is steady. The concern is supply: the category's fill rate over the last four weeks is 79%, and only 76% of purchase-order lines reached us on time and in full.

Purrline Foods is the clearest supply problem. Its recent fill rate is 54% against 98% earlier, and its open PO is past due. Ocean Fish Adult is down to 6 days of cover.

NutriPaws's best seller, Peanut Butter Biscuits, is out of stock with 0 days of cover. It sold 329 units this week against 437 the week before, and the 600 units still due are not promised until 3 Nov.

Tailwind Play has 42% of its stock value in the oldest age bucket: slow movers that need a markdown or a return to the vendor. Groomwell's Deshedding Brush has 7.1% returns and a rating down 0.74 stars, and the returns mostly cite leaking packaging.
